fullPassage: Dictionaries are relatively good resources for anyone interested in finding out what a word means. Using one set of words to define another word is called a lexical definition. But it's important to understand the limits of dictionary definitions. More often than not, a definition in a dictionary requires readers to have a fairly robust understanding of the language already at their disposal. In other words, a dictionary functions in many cases as a cross-reference or translator between words one knows and words that one doesn't yet know. However, there are words that may be defined not through other words but only by pointing to something in our experience. Even the most obscure words in a dictionary, say, for example, "pulchritudinous" or "kalokagathia," must be defined using words that the reader already knows and understands. Otherwise, the dictionary isn't very helpful.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 사전은 누구에게나 완벽한 언어 학습 도구이다.
사전 정의를 사용하려면 독자가 이미 상당한 언어 이해력을 갖추고 있어야 하는 경우가 많다.
어휘적 정의(lexical definition)는 사물을 직접 가리켜 의미를 전달하는 방식이다.
사전에서 가장 어려운 단어들은 다른 단어를 사용하지 않고도 정의될 수 있다.

det.korean: 사전 정의를 사용하려면 독자가 이미 상당한 언어 이해력을 갖추고 있어야 하는 경우가 많다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 본문: 'a definition in a dictionary requires readers to have a fairly robust understanding of the language already at their disposal' — 일치 ←정답
❌ ① 본문: 사전이 '비교적 좋은(relatively good)' 자료라고 하며, 한계가 있음을 강조
❌ ③ 본문: 어휘적 정의는 한 단어로 다른 단어를 정의하는 것. 경험을 직접 가리키는 것은 별도 방식
❌ ④ 본문: 가장 모호한 단어조차 독자가 이미 아는 단어로 정의되어야 한다고 함

questions.passage: Dictionaries are relatively good resources for anyone interested in finding out what a word means. Using one set of words to define another word is called a lexical definition. But it's important to understand the limits of dictionary definitions. More often than not, a definition in a dictionary requires readers to have a fairly robust understanding of the language already at their disposal. In other words, a dictionary functions in many cases as a cross-reference or translator between words one knows and words that one doesn't yet know. However, there are words that may be defined not through other words but only by pointing to something in our experience. Even the most obscure words in a dictionary, say, for example, "pulchritudinous" or "kalokagathia," must be defined using words that the reader already knows and understands. Otherwise, the dictionary isn't very helpful.
